headline: MiniMax's m3.1-flash takes #1 for the first time, with 17.6% of tokens
summary: MiniMax's minimax-m3.1-flash claimed the top spot for the first time, carrying 17.6% of tokens and staying on day 2 of its all-time share record. DeepSeek's v4.1-flash is right behind at 16.3%, and the top two providers together hold 48.1%.
highlights: Day 2 of MiniMax's all-time token-share record, and now it's sitting at the top of the leaderboard too.
DeepSeek's deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 is the runner-up at 16.3%, and DeepSeek as a provider holds 29.9% on its own.
DeepSeek and MiniMax together hold 48.1%; adding Zhipu AI lifts the top three to 55.7%.
StepFun's step-5-preview had a rough day, dropping 10 spots to 23rd, and is down 13.4% in share over seven days.
New on the board: x-ai/grok-4.7 debuts at 42nd and google/gemini-3.7-flash at 48th, while xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 and google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite fell off the list.
